summary_en: This study looks at brain function in patients with multiple brain metastases from solid tumors who are treated with stereotactic radiosurgery (SRS) or stereotactic body radiation therapy (SBRT). SRS is given as one treatment on day 1, and SBRT is given in 3 fractions over days 1 to 7. The study measures neurocognitive function (thinking and brain-related abilities) at baseline, 4 months, and 12 months after treatment.
summary_es: Este estudio analiza la función cerebral en pacientes con múltiples metástasis cerebrales de tumores sólidos que reciben radiocirugía estereotáxica (SRS) o radioterapia corporal estereotáxica (SBRT). La SRS se administra como un solo tratamiento el día 1, y la SBRT se administra en 3 fracciones durante los días 1 a 7. El estudio mide la función neurocognitiva (capacidades de pensamiento y funcionamiento relacionadas con el cerebro) al inicio, a los 4 meses y a los 12 meses después del tratamiento.
who_for: Pathologically proven solid tumor (except small cell lung cancer and germ cell tumor)
Karnofsky performance status of 60 or higher
1 to 10 brain metastases, with size limits on the largest lesions
Serum creatinine and creatinine clearance within stated limits
Able to complete neurocognitive testing, give written consent, and speak English
not_for: Glioma or other WHO grade II to IV primary brain tumor
Brain surgery within 14 days before enrollment
